task.title: Pin the re-scoped Qwen3.5-0.8B pack in AI_MODEL_MANIFEST and run verify:ai-model-live on it
task.objective: Add the Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M pack to src/offline/AiModelManifest.ts from values measured on the downloaded file at 3fa15327: 527,502,816 bytes and SHA-256 f5b14da98939b60bbe1019a964eba656407e1e0b64f1fe3003ff6d650e93bfec (equal to the published object), and from its own GGUF header GGUF v3, 320 tensors, general.architecture qwen35, general.name Qwen_Qwen3.5 0.8B, qwen35.context_length 262144, general.file_type 15 (Q4_K_M). Record its Apache-2.0 license in resources/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The 4B entry and AI_RUNTIME_PIN stay as they are: retiring an accepted pack is not requested. Then run verify:ai-model-live-0-8b, which imports the pack through AiModelPackStore with the real manifest and requires the entry to match the header, plus verify:ai-model-pack and the build. The model artifact, deadlines, output budgets and benchmark criteria are unchanged, nothing is wired, and L7 is not entered.

acceptance.description: The 0.8B entry's size and SHA-256 are the downloaded file's, and its context length and quantization are its own GGUF header's, each asserted by verify:ai-model-live-0-8b, and the pack imports through AiModelPackStore with the real manifest and passes load verification.
The typecheck and bundles pass with the new entry.

evidence.observed: 23/0 on the pinned state. Before the pin the same gate was 17/1 at 3fa15327, the one failure the expected 'AI_MODEL_MANIFEST lists the measured pack', which is where the entry's values come from. Pinned: published object, runtime pin, entry listed; GGUF v3, 320 tensors, qwen35, Qwen_Qwen3.5 0.8B, context 262144 and file type 15 equal to the entry's contextTokens and quantization; imported through AiModelPackStore with the real manifest in 3 s, status installed, load verification re-hashed and accepted; all 13 live harness steps passed (constrained decoding, determinism, injection text, no think block, special-token literalness, prompt bound, truncation, cancel in 4.0 s, deadline, yield, crash recovery with reload, shutdown).
46/0: every production entry well formed, ids and checksums unique, 2 pinned packs, runtime build node-llama-cpp@3.21.1+llama.cpp@v0.4.0.
tsc --noEmit and electron-vite build passed with the new entry; typecheck:scripts also passed at 3fa15327.

completion.qa_basis: The pinned entry is measured, not copied: size and SHA-256 from the file, context length and quantization from its own GGUF header, each asserted by verify:ai-model-live-0-8b 23/0, with verify:ai-model-pack 46/0 and the build passing.
completion.qa_known_limitations: The 4B entry stays pinned: retiring an accepted pack was not requested and is the owner's call. validate:offline was NOT RUN: it checks the packaged runtime, browser and dependency manifest, and the model pack is never bundled. verify:ai-model-live on the 4B was NOT RUN after the --pack change. No independent QC review was run: subagents were not requested. L1 stays open.
